docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
1. Install the plugin via pip: 
    pip install mkdocs-doubleslash-theme
  2. Add the plugin to your mkdocs.yml and enable the mkdocs-material theme: 
    theme: material

plugins:
  - search
  - mkdocs-doubleslash-theme

That's it! The plugin will automatically:

  • Apply a custom stylesheet with the doubleSlash styles
  • Set the doubleSlash logo and favicon (if no custom logo is configured)
  • Configure the Material for MkDocs theme with the doubleSlash color palette

docs.title: Styled elements
docs.text: The sections below render the elements the theme restyles, so a change to the stylesheet can be checked in both color schemes on a single page.

docs.title: Headings
docs.text: Headings use Inter SemiBold on the docs type scale, from 45px for the page title down to 18px for level 6.

docs.title: Text and links
docs.text: Body copy is Inter at 18px on a 27px line. Inline markup covers bold, italic, inline code and a link, which stays free of an underline until hovered.

docs.title: Lists
docs.text:
• Unordered items are marked with a chevron instead of a bullet

  • The marker color follows the active color scheme

    • Nested levels keep the same marker

  • Ordered lists keep Material's numbering

  • Second item

docs.text:
Token Value Used for --ds-color-primary #00759e Links, accents, active navigation --ds-color-border #6d6d6d Content divider, control outlines, tab sets --ds-rounded-md 10px Search field, tooltip and table corners

Header cells carry no fill, the body sits inside a rounded outline, rows are separated by hairlines and tint on hover.

docs.title: Tabbed content
docs.text:
Requires pymdownx.tabbed with alternate_style: true.

pipuv 
pip install mkdocs-doubleslash-theme

uv add mkdocs-doubleslash-theme

docs.title: Table of contents and layout controls
docs.text: The right sidebar can be collapsed with the round button next to it, and the navigation sidebar with the button on the content divider. Both appear on viewports wide enough to show the respective sidebar.
